maximum_depth_rule: All 20 canonical Phase 9 Reviewed statements are retained exactly once with their registered document, PDF location, raw text, tokens, unit, scope, operator, and unresolved comparability boundary.
version_boundary: The 2023 to 2026 plan, fiscal 2024 and fiscal 2025 KGI revisions, upward revisions, additions, partial reviews, overview pamphlet, annual reporting, and resident sentiment remain separate versions and layers.
non_goals: Do not infer records from the overview pamphlet document with zero reviewed rows.
Do not merge fiscal 2024 and fiscal 2025 revisions into one unreviewed value series.
Do not convert national rank, prior value, revised value, or revision rationale into verified annual outcomes.
Do not calculate policy achievement, causality, or cross-prefecture ranking.
